responsibility: This definition module declares the token-buffer and source-location service that sits between the external lexer and mc’s parser passes. It exposes the current token/value globals, buffered token traversal and insertion operations, pass resets, comment retrieval hooks, token-number to line/column/file mapping, and the callback interface used by the lexer to append tokens and file-stack changes into the buffer.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the Modula-2 definition interface for the mcLexBuf token buffer, exposing parser-visible globals and procedures to other Modula-2 modules. Unlike mcLexBuf.mod it does not implement storage/replay, and unlike mcLexBuf.h it is not the C foreign-function header for lexer/GCC-side consumers.
